thesis.body: Every model can write the code, the article, the level. That part gets cheaper every quarter. What we bring is the part after the model: the checks, the cross-references and the human sign-off that decide whether its output is allowed to ship.

studio.title: Small studio, unreasonable range
studio.body: LumiVerse is a founder-led AI product studio in Zagreb. We build our own products and embed with teams to build theirs. The same hands that rebuilt a ten-year-old rent-a-car system also run an agentic simulation station that computes plasma-display physics. Range isn’t a lack of focus. It’s the focus.

principles.title: We eat our own cooking
principles.body: Titlomat, Tvrtko.ai and Country Guides are our products in production, with real users. We know what shipping costs because we pay it ourselves.

principles.title: We embed, we don’t hover
principles.body: For a UK intelligence platform we’ve owned the architecture, a 17-service system and release sign-off for over a year.

principles.title: Honest about the hard parts
principles.body: Every case study says what needed a human and what’s still rough.
